name: reconcile_exit_advisory_undated_bars_20261109
comment: LQ-1706: a bar source whose bars carry no date measures no window, so the exit-advisory reconciler skips the pair as bars_unavailable instead of writing permanent NOT_EVALUABLE rows and reporting produced=N; a run whose only obstacle was the bar source exits 1 with dependency_unavailable. A dated series that merely starts after one advisory's window still writes NOT_EVALUABLE.
